description: Update the organization profile and maturity targets (write — admin): business_size, mission_statement, maturity_targets. Partial: only passed fields change.

business_size.description: Business size, which picks the matching row of each control's right-sizing guidance: micro_small, small, medium, large, enterprise; null clears

maturity_targets.description: Target maturity per SCF domain code (domain code → L0–L5), e.g. {"GOV": "L3"}. Replaces the whole map; {} clears every target. Unknown domain codes, or one code given twice in different case, are refused (422). A control's own target (scf_set_target_maturity) overrides its domain's

mission_statement.description: Mission statement (up to 4000 chars); blank or null clears

name: scf_update_org_settings
